## Status note

`build.gradle.kts` currently only declares the `java` plugin + JUnit Jupiter — none of the
below are wired up yet. This file declares the **target** stack per `src/SPEC.md` so future
`/ss:build` work builds toward the intended architecture instead of drifting. Update the
"Current build.gradle.kts state" line each time a module lands.

Current build.gradle.kts state: `java` plugin, JUnit 6 (jupiter) via `junit-bom`.

## Language

- **Java**
  - Rationale: SPEC.md Tech Stack table.

## Game engine

- **LibGDX** (core, android, desktop modules)
  - Rationale: cross-platform 2D game engine; desktop module enables fast local iteration without an emulator.

## Architecture

- **MVVM**
  - Rationale: SPEC.md Tech Stack table.

## Dependency injection

- **Hilt**

## Local persistence

- **Room**
  - Stores: match history, unlocks, bracket state, win/loss record.
  - Cloud sync: none for MVP (Firestore is an explicit post-MVP stretch goal — see SPEC.md "Stretch Goal: Firestore Cloud Sync").

## Auth

- **Patreon OAuth2**
  - Scope: unlock verification only. No mandatory login to play.

## In-app purchases

- **Google Play Billing Library v6+**

## Asset management

- **LibGDX AssetManager**
  - All sprites referenced by key, swappable when real art replaces placeholders.

## Platform constraints

- Orientation: landscape only, locked.
- Min SDK: 21 (Android 5.0)
- Target SDK: 35 (Android 15)

## Testing

- **Unit test**: JUnit Jupiter 6 (`junit-bom` 6.0.0), via `junit-platform-launcher`.
- **Integration / e2e**: not yet configured. No Android instrumentation test setup present.

## Version history

- 2026-07-07 (Feature 001): pinned LibGDX 1.14.2, AGP 9.2.1/Gradle 9.4.1; compileSdk 36. No conflicts, no prohibited tech touched. Hilt/Room/Billing/OAuth/Firestore remain target-stack-only (explicitly NOT scaffolded in Feature 001).

## Prohibited technologies

- ❌ Online / async PvP — explicit non-goal (SPEC.md "Non-Goals").
- ❌ Character stat upgrades / progression meta — explicit non-goal.
- ❌ Leaderboards — explicit non-goal.
- ❌ Mandatory login to play — auth is unlock-verification only.

## Open decisions

- `[OPEN]` Circuit vs. Tournament data model: `TournamentBracket.mode` is currently flat
  (`CIRCUIT | TOURNAMENT`); a `Circuit` entity holding an ordered list of `Tournament` ids
  is likely needed before post-MVP Circuit work starts. See SPEC.md Gap 10c.
- `[OPEN]` Patreon token re-verification cadence (SPEC.md "Open Questions" #1).
- `[OPEN]` Pass-and-play scope — stretch goal, unspecified; would affect the input layer and match state machine if it enters scope (SPEC.md Gap 14).
